html:
You are a virtual life enthusiast, you want to find yourself virtual living spots in Saigon, but where are the virtual living spots? Let’s follow Vietlook Travel to review the virtual living spots below.

1. Landmark 81

A beautiful check-in spot that many tourists visit, this is one of the tallest buildings in Saigon and also a bustling shopping center. Coming here, you will be able to freely live virtually right on the campus or inside the building, you can capture beautiful pictures.

If you want to relax, you can enjoy a cup of coffee right outside the building, and admire the magnificent Saigon scenery, which will definitely bring you beautiful pictures.

2. Bach Dang Wharf

Coming here, visitors will encounter a poetic space, you can buy a waterbus ticket to explore the beauty of the peaceful Saigon River, or you can enjoy a cup of coffee watching the scenery at dusk, and record beautiful pictures of the magical sunset, an indispensable destination when traveling to Saigon.

3. Nguyen Hue Walking Street

This is a neighborhood that many tourists come to check in, and is where many exciting programs and interesting games take place, very suitable for young people. Not only that, around the neighborhood there are also many bustling shopping centers, very convenient for visitors to visit and sightsee during their vacation.

4. Khanh An Monastery

This is a place with a beautiful view that attracts young people to come here to take virtual photos, surrounded by a cool green campus, with rows of shady green trees. However, this is a monastery, so visitors should dress politely and elegantly when coming here.

5. Saigon Post Office

Located right in the city center, with classic French architecture, visitors can check in for themselves beautiful photos with that ancient look, no matter what angle they stand from, visitors can capture beautiful photos for themselves.

6. City Theater

Built in a classic style, imbued with magnificent European architecture, this place has a large and airy space, so many couples come here to take wedding photos on their big day.

7. Bui Vien Western Street

This is one of the bustling streets with rows of bars, pubs, eateries, restaurants or luxurious hotels, the space here is colorful, so if you check in at Bui Vien you will have beautiful photos.

8. Ho Chi Minh City Museum of Fine Arts

A beautiful place to take portrait photos, coming here visitors will encounter classic architecture but still exude its own beauty. Therefore, this place is chosen as a virtual living spot that many young people come to when they have the opportunity to go on a tour of Saigon and the Museum of Fine Arts is the perfect destination for every vacation.

9. Starlight Bridge

The bridge has the most beautiful scenery in Saigon, with LED lighting systems, you can walk at night to feel its own beauty, a romantic scene that many young people come to have fun and take virtual photos.

10. Buu Long Pagoda

The pagoda is built in the architectural style of Thailand, looks very unique and has become a luxurious photo-taking view point that many tourists come to, especially young people or foreign tourists, come here to visit and check in on the temple grounds.

So above are the most beautiful virtual living spots in Saigon, hopefully it will help your trip. Especially for foreign tourists when going on a tour Vietnam but do not know which places to choose to record beautiful pictures during their tour in Saigon, this article will be suggestions for you.
